group.name: Academic Profile Hub
group.tagline: A Platform for Scholars and Researchers.
group.description: Academic Profile Hub is a collaborative platform dedicated to showcasing academic profiles, research activities, publications, projects, and achievements. It brings students, scholars, and researchers together in one place to share knowledge, explore ideas, and foster academic collaboration. Our mission is to connect minds, inspire research, and promote a culture of continuous learning and innovation.

members.name: Dr. Arnab Sengupta
members.shortBio: Geoinformatics researcher specializing in multi-sensor thermal remote sensing, urban climate adaptation, and spatial hydrology.
members.fullBio: Dr. Aarav Sen leads the Urban Climate & Spatial Geoinformatics track within the Meridian Research Collective. His work combines synthetic aperture radar (SAR), thermal infrared satellite imagery, and physics-informed spatial machine learning to quantify heat vulnerability and stormwater retention across rapidly urbanizing river basins. Prior to joining Horizon Institute of Technology, he held a postdoctoral fellowship in Environmental Remote Sensing in Zurich and has authored over twenty peer-reviewed monographs and journal articles.

members.name: Dr. Elena Vance
members.shortBio: Quantitative ecologist integrating airborne LiDAR canopy structure with bioacoustic monitoring and biodiversity informatics.
members.fullBio: Dr. Elena Vance investigates how forest structural complexity regulates microclimate buffering and avian biodiversity across temperate mountain corridors. Her laboratory pairs terrestrial and airborne laser scanning (LiDAR) with autonomous passive acoustic arrays to build scalable, non-invasive biodiversity indicators for conservation agencies and long-term ecological research networks.

members.name: Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor
members.designation: Senior Research Fellow in Environmental IoT
members.shortBio: Systems computer scientist designing ultra-low-power sensor networks and spatiotemporal graph neural networks for field telemetry.
members.fullBio: Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor bridges embedded hardware systems and spatiotemporal machine learning. His research focuses on resilient LoRaWAN and satellite-backhauled environmental sensor nodes deployed in remote watersheds and dense urban canyons, paired with graph-based imputation models that reconcile sparse ground telemetry with continuous Earth observation grids.

members.name: Maya Chakraborty
members.shortBio: Glaciology and hydrology doctoral researcher mapping high-mountain snowmelt runoff and debris-covered glacier dynamics using InSAR.
members.fullBio: Maya Chakraborty is a fourth-year Ph.D. candidate investigating mountain cryosphere hydrology and glacial meltwater contributions to downstream basins. Combining Sentinel-1 interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR), high-resolution optical stereogrammetry, and in-situ stream gauging, her doctoral research develops reproducible cloud-native geospatial pipelines to track seasonal glacier velocity and meltwater storage.
